content: Hold a true and faithful friend with both your hands.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Flatterers and fair-weather acquaintances are as plentiful as gravel on the road. But a friend who speaks truth, guards your back in slander, and sits with you in silent grief is rarer than rubies. Never let petty arguments loosen your grip on a loyal friend.
practicalInsight: Take five minutes today to call or message a steadfast friend. Let them know you hold their loyalty with both hands.
reflectionPrompt: Have you been taking a loyal friend for granted because of minor, petty irritations?
